ULTIMATE COMPLETE- 1 hour dance class of your choice then 1.5 hour party. IPAC supplies all decorations, plates, cups and utensils. Pizza, drinks and cake provided. $365 All parties are allowed to have 15 kids. Each additional kid is $5 extra. $50 for each additional hour. You can choose any style of dance ( ex. Jazz, Hip-Hop, Line Dancing, Ballet) and any theme for the party. (Themes: KPop Demon Hunters, Taylor Swift, Frozen, Mermaid, Princess, Ballerina, Trolls , etc) You can bring any outside food or decorations. We can add a craft to your party for an additional $30.
